annotation.title_clean: Commission Directive 2012/46/EU of 6 December 2012 amending Directive 97/68/EC on emissions from internal combustion engines to be installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.title_en: Commission Directive 2012/46/EU of 6 December 2012 amending Directive 97/68/EC on emissions from internal combustion engines to be installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union L 353/80
annotation.summary_en: Commission Directive amending the EU non-road mobile machinery engine emissions directive (97/68/EC). It sets Stage IV type-approval test requirements, NOx control and operator warning/inducement systems, durability and deterioration factors, CO2 reporting and crankcase emissions rules. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds Stage IV NOx control measures with operator warning and two-stage inducement (torque reduction, disablement) systems
Revises durability requirements with deterioration factors for Stage IIIA/IIIB/IV engines
Introduces control area testing and crankcase emission rules
Requires CO2 reporting and aligns tests with UNECE Regulation 96.03
Member States must transpose by 21 December 2013
